children: Stacks' third Bitcoin staking bonding period, Bonding Period 3, is expected to open around November 10, 2026. Participants can apply for self-custodial Bitcoin staking capacity, while pooled Bitcoin staking runs through Stacks ecosystem partners.

Participants bond STX to access Bitcoin staking capacity, linking participation directly to demand for locking the token. The prior round sold out approximately 500 BTC of capacity and involved 6.7 million STX, showing how this access mechanism translates into token lockups. Those figures describe the previous round. Actual uptake and scale for Bond 3 are not established, so the earlier totals do not indicate how much capacity will be taken or how much STX will be bonded.
Participants can apply for self-custodial capacity, and pooled Bitcoin staking runs through Stacks ecosystem partners.

title: Stacks: Bonding Period 3 opens Bitcoin staking access - By 10 Nov 2026
